answer_1.quote: This work aims to address the problem of long document summarization using constrained resources, specifically focusing on constrained GPU memory.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate summary informativeness using ROUGE. To measure coherence, we use DiscoScore (Disco)... We also report a graph-based reference-free coherence metric... For summary faithfulness, a recent model-based faithfulness metric, SummaC, is used.

answer_4.quote: We ask three fluent English speakers that have extensive NLP data annotation experience to examine the outputs by BlockAttn, Se3, and AWESOME...
answer_4.guideline: For each summary sentence, the annotators give binary labels on where the sentence is coherent—it uses natural transitions to logically connect with the previous content, and does not contradict any prior statement. The annotators also compare each summary sentence with the document and check if it is faithful... We further ask the annotators to rank the summaries generated by the three systems based on their informativeness...
